training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.

primary_metric: Equal-category/condition macro pixel AP over the six shifts within each paired seed
scope: Single predeclared ablation of anchor weight 0.1 to 0, after A1 selection; previously inspected categories. Preserve A1; no retuning or SOTA claim.
restrictions: Reuse unchanged pilot fit_one with method selector A1 and anchor_weight=0; no other training/feature/scoring change.
Reuse hashed normal-only feature caches. Verify identical initialization, batches, references and final step against A1.
All nine heads are fitted before separate evaluation. Reuse published, audited A0/A1 controls; disclose reuse and do not compare cross-session latency causally.
No early stopping, sweep, refit or new method selection; report all outcomes.

qualitative.candidates: Anomalous test images only in each category
qualitative.selection: Rank A1-minus-A0 per-image pixel AP; choose worst, then closest-to-median remaining image; lexicographic path breaks ties. No-anchor scores are never used to select examples.
qualitative.display: Input, mask, A0, A1, A1-no-anchor; same raw-distance color range for all three methods in a row (0 to joint maximum). No per-method normalization.
qualitative.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive examples, not representative rates or tuning data.
